problem_statement: Assess whether a new AWS storage capability can simplify application file sharing workflows.
current_approach: The current approach depends on direct S3 API integration and is harder for file-oriented workloads.
desired_outcome: Identify whether the capability is worth a small controlled PoC for bidirectional file access.
success_criteria: S1 can extract the AWS service and official claims from the article.
S3 can decide whether the candidate is eligible for human PoC review.
Any S4 PoC proposal stays within the USD 3 small-PoC limit.
